news.title: Volusia County Population Reaches 568,229
news.summary: According to the latest US Census ACS 5-Year estimates, Volusia County's population has grown to 568,229 residents.

news.title: BLS QCEW Data Shows 168,400 Employed in Volusia
news.summary: Bureau of Labor Statistics QCEW data for Q3 2024 shows total employment in Volusia County at 168,400 with 12,450 establishments.

news.title: NOAA Reports 122 Heat Days Above 90F in 2024
news.summary: NOAA NCEI climate data shows Volusia County experienced 122 days with temperatures above 90F and 108 days with precipitation in 2024.

news.title: Median Home Value at $332,954 per Zillow ZHVI
news.summary: Zillow's ZHVI index shows Volusia County's median home value at $332,954 with a year-over-year change of -1.6%.

news.title: CVB Reports $14.2M in Bed Tax Revenue for 2024
news.summary: Volusia County CVB reports $14.2 million in bed tax revenue and $2.8 billion in visitor spending for 2024.
